thread:
mel-cs: heads-up: Auriga reports rising monthly inference spend and a handful of "entity canonicalization" errors in finance chat. renewal ~45d. health drifting amber. thinking a low-risk cost play: intent/confidence routing + compact model hop + opt-in int8. reactions?
omar-ml: makes sense. their traffic is ~72% short Q/A, 15% long summaries. cost and p95 tail concentrated on Q/A.
li-se: routing by intent + confidence threshold is straightforward. propose: if model.confidence < 0.7 -> route to fp summarizer, else route faq to nimble-qa-lite (int8 candidate). start with 3% traffic canary.
sam: customer said "faster but ticker formatting sometimes changes" in a support ticket. they want an objective check on formatting before we go past 20%. add that to gates.
omar-ml: eval plan: build a 400-case entity-preservation suite from recent anonymized queries. metrics: entity_F1, latency_p95, cost_per_1k. gates: entity_F1 >= prod - 1.0% and no UX-formatting failures in sampled checks.
li-se: rollout sketch: phases 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 72h with auto-rollback if entity_F1 drops >1.5% in 60m or formatting check fails 3 samples in a row. enable prefix KV cache for repeated faq prefixes (cache.prefix_ttl=300s).
omar-ml: quick savings estimate: nimble-qa-lite int8 -> ~30% token cost reduction on faq path, overall monthly ~12-18% depending on mix. p95 latency down ~25-35%. expect small accuracy delta (~0.5%).
li-se: can implement fallback chain: nimble-qa-lite -> prod-int8-fallback -> prod-fp. will add per-customer override toggle in console.
sam: i'll surface the eval-set to Auriga for sign-off and ask for a small user-visible formatting A/B.
deploy-bot: ticket CS-2107 created "Auriga compact-routing pilot" assigned to @omar-ml,@li-se,@mel-cs due 2026-04-10. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-2107 :white_check_mark:
omar-ml: command I'll run: `./eval --model redwood/nimble-qa-lite-int8 --dataset auriga_entities_400.json --metrics entity_F1,latency_p95,cost`
mel-cs: thanks team 1 next steps: run eval, share raw numbers + counterexamples, li prepare canary script + route, sam get customer's sign-off and A/B cohort. I'll draft renewal note once we have canary results. :thumbsup:
